description: This file defines the class MutableResourceBundleMessageSource, which extends Spring's ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource to add functionalities for managing message resources within the OpenMRS platform. It implements mutable message source features, including locale management, dynamic message addition/removal, and merging message sources.

classes.name: MutableResourceBundleMessageSource
classes.description: A class that extends ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource to provide mutable message source features such as adding, removing, and merging message entries, along with locale management.

methods.name: getLocales
methods.description: Returns the collection of available locales, caching the result based on cacheMilliseconds setting.

methods.name: setCacheSeconds
methods.description: Sets the cache timeout in seconds for message translations.

methods.name: findLocales
methods.description: Discovers available locales by inspecting message property files.

methods.name: parseLocaleFrom
methods.description: Parses a locale object from a filename based on convention.

methods.name: getPresentations
methods.description: Returns all message presentations loaded from message properties files.

methods.name: setBasename
methods.description: Overrides to store the basename in a local variable.

methods.name: setBasenames
methods.description: Overrides to store basenames in a local variable and extend with module file URLs.

methods.name: addPresentation
methods.description: Adds or updates a message presentation in the appropriate properties file.

methods.name: removePresentation
methods.description: Removes a message presentation from its properties file.

methods.name: findPropertiesFileFor
methods.description: Locates the properties file that contains a message with the given code.

methods.name: findPropertiesFiles
methods.description: Searches classpath and module directories for message properties files.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another MutableMessageSource into this one, optionally overwriting existing messages.

methods.name: getPresentation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific message presentation by key and locale. Not yet implemented.

methods.name: getPresentationsInLocale
methods.description: Retrieves all message presentations in a specific locale. Not yet implemented.
